name: ANGILA VACCARO
bioAdditions: The San Mango parish burial index has the entry on 8 January 1712 (S1), matching the tree's death date.
funFacts: The 1712 burial register is exceptional: 129 burials that year, 53 of them in December, against a normal 10-30 a year. Several of John's ancestors died in that wave.

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Tree data match an indexed San Mango parish entry (derivative index of a primary register; image online but not read by me).

sources.citation: San Mango d'Aquino (CZ), parish of San Tommaso d'Aquino, Morti 1687-1713 (Book 3), image 176, p. 309, no. 1; volunteer index 'Indici Morti - San Mango D'Aquino - Chiese di San Tommaso 1653-1713, 1747-1767, 1811-1942.xlsx' (ItalianParishRecords.org, San Mango d'Aquino page; indexers incl. D. Lupia and J. Bifano/Epifano), sheet '1687-1713'.
